title: The entropy production is not always monotone in the space-homogeneous Boltzmann equation
summary: We show an example of a function and a collision kernel for which the entropy production increases in time when we flow it by the space-homogeneous Boltzmann equation. The collision kernel is not any of the physically motivated kernels that are commonly used in the literature. In this particular setting, our result disproves a conjecture of McKean from 1966.
